content: अभ्युपगम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 .³({%a%}) To go to or near, approach; परलोकमभ्युपगते (भर्तरि) विविशुः <ls>Śi. 9. 13</ls>. .³({%b%}) To come to the help of; वयमभ्युपगच्छामः कृष्णेन त्वां प्रधर्षितम् <ls>Hariv.</ls> .³({%c%}) To have recourse to. .³({%d%}) To arrive at (a point of time); आषाढीमभ्युपगतो भरतः <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 To obtain, get. .²3 To admit, grant, own; अभ्युपगतं तावदस्माभिरेवम् <ls>Ś. 5</ls> we admit all this; <ls>Mu. 3</ls>. .²4 To assent to, agree to, undertake, promise; <ls>Dk. 73</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To induce or cause one to assent to or grant; मामभ्युपगमय्य <ls>Dk. 60</ls>, <ls n="Dk.">118</ls>.
